text:
ara: Heads-up — several onboarding/sample repos are failing after we pushed the export-map change in 3.0.0-rc. Users on Vercel Edge and some bundlers are hitting weird resolution errors.

ara: Example from a user repro: `Uncaught ReferenceError: Headers is not defined` coming from our telemetry wrapper when running on Vercel Edge.

nick: I pulled the package tarball. package.json now has `exports` that only exposes `.` with an `import` target (`dist/index.mjs`) and a `./runtime` entry. No deep subpath exports for `./auth` or `./telemetry/edge`. That likely explains both the deep-import and env mismatch.

lina: Also seeing TypeScript complaints in sample CI: `Could not find a declaration file for module '@redwood/inference-js'`. The `exports` map is hiding the `.d.ts` files for some TS resolver versions.

ara: repro steps: `npx create-redwood-sample && npm i @redwood/inference-js@3.0.0-rc && vercel dev` — preview errors out. Locally forcing `node --input-type=module sample.mjs` picks the ESM entry and works, but Vercel's bundler picks a server-only path.

nick: Two separate problems: (A) subpath imports used by some samples (`@redwood/inference-js/lib/auth`, `@redwood/inference-js/telemetry/edge`) are no longer resolvable, (B) conditional exports cause bundlers to pick server-side telemetry code because the edge-specific conditional wasn't present.

lina: Quick mitigation options: revert to a dual-entry exports map that provides both `import` and `require` targets for `.`, add explicit subpath exports for `./auth`, `./telemetry/edge`, `./adapters/*`, and declare a top-level `types` field that points to `dist/index.d.ts`. Also include `"./package.json": "./package.json"` in exports so bundlers can read package fields.

ara: For TypeScript, add `typesVersions` mapping so older TS (<4.5) can still resolve d.ts files when exports hide them. That should fix the CI `Could not find a declaration file` errors.

nick: Runtime guard: our auth retry currently does `if (typeof fetch !== 'function') throw new Error('fetch not available')`. For edge runtimes that polyfill fetch on globalThis, this check misfires in some bundler transforms. Change to `const _fetch = (typeof globalThis !== 'undefined' && globalThis.fetch) ? globalThis.fetch : undefined;` and only fallback to `node-fetch` when `_fetch` is undefined at runtime. Keep the require lazy.

lina: I'll draft the package.json patch snippet: 
```
"exports": {
  ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs", "default": "./dist/index.cjs" },
  "./auth": { "import": "./dist/auth/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/auth/index.cjs" },
  "./telemetry/edge": { "import": "./dist/telemetry/edge.mjs" },
  "./package.json": "./package.json"
},
"main": "dist/index.cjs",
"module": "dist/index.mjs",
"types": "dist/index.d.ts",
'typesVersions': { "*": { "*": [ "dist/*.d.ts" ] } }
```

ara: small caveat: avoid exposing too many internal paths long-term; let's restore the minimal set we promised (auth, adapters, telemetry/edge) and add a short deprecation note for other deep imports.

ci-bot: CI started for branch fix/exportmap-3.0.0-rc-compat  build 72 triggered.

nick: Also add a lightweight Deno and Cloudflare Worker smoke test to the release checklist; CDNs and Deno import users are very sensitive to subpath exports.

lina: I'll update the samples repo to pin to the compatibility patch once published and add one test that imports `@redwood/inference-js/telemetry/edge` from a minimal Cloudflare Worker script.

types-bot: Quick note: if you set `types` in package.json, also ensure the d.ts files are included in the published tarball (check `files`/npmignore). Some previous publishes omitted them.

ara: thanks — Jin had that issue in the past. We need a small checklist: (1) ensure d.ts are present in package tarball, (2) add `./package.json` export, (3) restore minimal subpath exports, (4) update runtime fetch guard, (5) run Deno/Cloudflare smoke tests.

ci-bot: Lint failed on PR (line length). Small fix pushed.

nick: PR merged and 3.0.0-rc.1 published to npm with compatibility exports. Samples smoke-runner verified Vercel preview + Node + Deno import.

ara: closing thread. Follow-ups: add deprecation note for deep imports in docs, and add automated publish smoke tests for edge CDNs in the release pipeline. :white_check_mark:
